Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concludes the Dinosaur release date is confirmed based on incomplete data from the WebSurfer, who had not yet successfully extracted the date from the Wikipedia page. This misinterpretation of upstream data creates a false sense of completion, leading to redundant search loops and delaying the final conclusion.
